name: Anubis
body:
Known as Guardian of the Tomb, God of Graves, and The Final Usher, Anubis is responsible for escorting the souls of the dead to the judgment grounds.

Anubis appears as a human male with the head of a black jackal. In his role as preserver of bodies, caretaker of cemeteries, and usher on the path to the judging fields, Anubis is the patron of embalmers, grave diggers, and necromancers.

Funerary

Granted Powers: Your deity is the ultimate escort, ushering souls on the path from death to the afterlife. As a guide, you can travel from plane to plane. You know when a soul is nearing death and your magic is strongly influenced by the necromantic arts. With GM permission, a cleric who has access to the repose domain can select the funerary domain in its place.

Stench of Death (Sp)

You can fill a living creature’s nostrils with the stench of death.

With a successful melee touch attack, the target becomes sickened for a number of rounds equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum 1). At 8th level, you can choose to inflict the nauseated condition instead, but it only lasts for 1 round.

You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier.

Weighing of the Heart (Sp)

At 8th level, as a standard action, you can select two creatures within 60 feet of you, declaring one to be worthy and the other to be unworthy. The worthy creature (this creature can be you) gains a sacred bonus on attack and damage rolls equal to your Wisdom modifier for 1 minute. The unworthy creature must make a Will save (DC 10 + 1/2 your level + your Wisdom modifier). On a failed save, the creature takes a penalty on attack and damage rolls equal to 1/2 your Wisdom modifier (round down, minimum 1) for 1 minute. On a successful save, the penalty only lasts 1 round instead. You can use this ability once per day at 8th level, and an additional time per day for every four levels beyond 8th.

Domain: 1st-status, 2nd-create pit, 3rd-spiked pit, 4th-aura of doom, 5th-plane shift, 6th-circle of death, 7th-finger of death, 8thhorrid wilting, 9th-gate.
